text: The rule package harness runs in SIT against the published contracts, replaces each fake as its I story lands, seeds the three package versions and the two payment cases through the owning contracts, drives the promotion through the 00:01 rulePackagePromote Schedule, and its evidence is a report per business date keyed by story and business date; a fake answers the documented status codes of the legacy contract and never invents a rule row.
why: The sources fix the owners, the operations, the events, every legacy value and the message IDs but give no harness repository, no SIT environment, no seeding set, no evidence format or retention, no pass or fail gate and no fake response bodies, and the run cannot wait for a decision on them.

text: The integration and QA harness for RWB-E3-006 is carried at status Draft on Day 1 with the following working read: one harness runner keyed by story and business date, five WireMock stubs (rwb-treatment, rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-decision, rwb-access) generated from the published contracts with each version pinned in the run report, one event probe over rwb.treatment.events.v1, rwb.case.events.v1 and rwb.decision-record.v1, and one evidence report per business date; SIT only, never UAT or production; seeding through the owning services' published operations only and never a schema write; the case at ROUTE_APPROVED_SETTLEMENT with its settlement treatment and the ALS payoff facts for its account; the payoff read through the P1 products contract and the range through the P3 reference-data contract; the pass or fail gate held on the evidence report and agreed at the wave 2 entry check. The harness repository, the SIT environment specification, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate wording, the data product code, the list code and the exact fake response values stay open placeholders in the story.
why: The story cannot be run on Day 1 without a stub set, a seeding route, one report shape and one gate, and no read source gives any of them: the legacy key gives behaviour, entities and two monolith endpoints, the rule table gives the states and the condition, the BRD gives the requirements, and the Ownership Map gives the owners. The working read therefore fixes only what the template and the read sources already imply (one runner, five owners' stubs, SIT only, seeding through published operations, one report per business date) and leaves every unnamed value as the §R9 placeholder rather than inventing it.
read: One JourneyRunner per business date; five contract stubs pinned to their published versions; one EventProbe over the three topics; one EvidenceReport per business date; SIT only; seeding through published operations only; the case at ROUTE_APPROVED_SETTLEMENT with its settlement treatment; the payoff through the P1 products contract and the range through the P3 reference-data contract; the gate on the evidence report; the harness repository, the SIT environment specification, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention, the gate wording, the data product code, the list code and the fake response values remain open.
confirm: QA lead, integration lead, P1 rwb-source-data, P3 rwb-case and the wave 2 entry check
impact: If the read is wrong, the run may seed a case the real services cannot accept, assert a range against the wrong list code or pass a stub whose response values differ from the published contract; the criterion stays provable against the owners' contracts and the harness is re-pointed rather than rewritten, and no business value is affected.

text: The harness environment, the seeding set, the evidence format and retention and the pass or fail gate are treated as harness configuration agreed at the wave 2 entry check: the journey runs in SIT against the published contracts and their fakes from Day 1 and against the real services as they land, all seeding uses only the owning services' published operations and never a schema write, one evidence report is written per business date keyed by story and business date, and the gate is the wave entry check holding that report with each contract and fixture version named.
why: The legacy key, the FSD and TSD module extracts, the Program BRD and the Arch v5 extract give no harness environment, no seeding set, no evidence format or retention and no pass or fail gate, and the story cannot be built or passed Done without them.
read: SIT; seeding through the owning services' published operations only; one report per business date keyed by story and business date; the wave entry check holds the report and names every contract and fixture version; no value is written in code.
confirm: QA lead with the integration lead at the wave 2 entry check; the agreed environment, seeding set, evidence format and retention and gate are attached to CG-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-1.
impact: The harness runs and its result is auditable in the agreed way; no business rule, state or date changes.

text: NLEADS and ALS are modelled by the outbound items on their interface configs in rwb-integration and, where the configured interface is a file, by one outbound fixture each, so the harness asserts the agreed terms leaving and the acknowledgement without assuming an interface code, a transport, a message or file layout, a result code or a test endpoint.
why: The legacy key names NLEADS and ALS as the systems the plan leaves to, but no source in the fill order gives their interface codes, transports, message or file layouts, result codes or test endpoints, and the harness cannot assert a delivery without some model of the interface.
read: One outbound item per interface, keyed by case and treatment, read through the rwb-integration admin operations; a delivery, a failure and a file outcome read from the same owner; no interface code, transport, layout, result code or endpoint invented, and the fixtures are configuration.
confirm: Integration lead with the P2 interface owners at the wave 2 entry check; the interface codes, transports, layouts, result codes and test endpoints are attached to CG-B-ITG-W2-08-E3010-1.
impact: The booking is asserted through the owner's interface config and its fixtures; no interface value is assumed in code and no business value changes.

text: The early readiness harness is one test-scope runner outside the deployed services, run on one SIT environment against WireMock stubs generated from the published contracts of rwb-treatment, rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-decision and rwb-access plus one CCMS or Land Office check fixture, with the contract version of every hop pinned in the report; its seed is two cases placed through the owners' published operations only (one at ROUTE_APPROVED_DIL with its deed-in-lieu treatment, one at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED with its title documents missing), its evidence is one report per story and business date, and its gate is all-green on the three criteria of section 7 with a stub pass reported as a stub pass and never as a real-owner pass.
why: FEAT-TRT-13 names CCMS and the Land Office as the systems of the check and gives no interface detail, the legacy key names no harness at all, and Architecture v5 gives the service contracts but no test environment, seeding set or evidence format, so the harness has to be placed somewhere before the story can be built and the wave can be entered.
read: RWB-E3-013 AC1 to AC4 and its data, endpoint and message tables; FEAT-TRT-13 and FEAT-TRT-12 of the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3; R-DIL-01 and R-SET-22 of the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4; Architecture v5 slides 13, 14, 15, 18, 41 and 44 (service catalogue, P3, P1, P7, P4 and S2 contracts, job map); DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19; the ownership map for treatment, case, task, assignment, decision_log_entry, v_ace_collateral, v_ace_collateral_detail and v_ace_npa_asset.
confirm: Integration lead and QA lead, with the tech leads of rwb-treatment (S2) and rwb-case (P3)
impact: If the check is called through a different owner, only the fixture name and one consumed operation change and the criteria, the assertion order and the evidence stay as they are; no business value, table or contract field is affected.
